design: the loop's design (d4-whole-loop), as revised after its first build package
table: C.2, the hard cases, walked on the rules of Appendix A: 34 rows

rows.title: A squash merge on the platform, no session
rows.says: the trunk holds it at `built`. Its `reviews` name a commit of the branch, which the trunk may not hold: after the merge it is history, and nothing reads it

rows.title: Merged on the platform before it was built
rows.says: S8, in a new change

findings: on the trunk before it was built

rows.title: Merged with a review missing, or a finding open
rows.says: `merged`, with a warning: a person merged it, and aidd does not undo that

rows.title: A commit after the review; a rebase, an amend, or an update from the default branch
rows.says: more than the Spec's own facts changed since the entry's commit, or that commit left the branch's history

variants.name: a commit after the review, and the evidence is for the older commit
a commit after the review, with the tests run again
a rebase: the reviewed commit left the branch's history
an update from the default branch

rows.title: Two reviews needed, one done; or one ended with a finding to fix
rows.says: S11 names `security`; or S11a sends the developer to the finding

variants.name: a security entry with a finding open

rows.title: A review entry in the commit that changes code, or with no note of its role
rows.says: the entry names an older commit; or no note agrees with it: it counts for nothing

variants.name: the entry rides in the commit that changes code
no note of the reviewing role agrees with the entry

rows.title: A Spec whose own words leave out `security`, with a path under `**/auth/**`
rows.says: the paths give the dimension, under the trunk's rules; a delegated `spec.approve` had deferred

rows.title: A stored word whose chain does not hold
rows.says: `ready` that no longer validates reads `draft`; `built` with no approval that holds, or with a `revisions` entry newer than its approval, reads `ready`. The frozen tests still read the stored word

variants.name: built with no approval that holds
built with a revisions entry newer than its approval

revisions.why: a person asked for a change

rows.title: A clone with no evidence file; a shallow clone
rows.says: the tests' result is one clone's file; the cover rule needs the history

variants.name: no evidence file on this clone

findings: tests: not run on this clone

rows.title: Deploy on merge
rows.says: the config names the trunk for production
rows.ambiguous: where the live commit is the trunk's tip, the design gives no day on which the observe window starts: the facts here take the window from the merge's own day

rows.title: Three environments; only sandbox is live
rows.says: `merged · sandbox <day> · production: not yet`

rows.title: A deploy nobody recorded, then a fresh session
rows.says: S13 asks "is it live?". The answer is a person's word, and no test runs it; on a yes the agent only records

told: a person answers whether it is already live

rows.title: An old `done` or `in_review` Spec on the trunk after the upgrade
rows.says: the old stored word, in a file no change touches
rows.ambiguous: no upgrade from pre-release shapes: the architect re-reads this row

rows.title: An old `in_review` in a Spec file that a change adds or changes
rows.says: the old word reads as `built` for the chain; `aidd validate` errors, and names `built`
rows.ambiguous: no upgrade from pre-release shapes: the architect re-reads this row

rows.title: The observe check failed, no rollback
The observe window ended, and nothing was written
A rollback by release, by revert, or by a button
rows.says: the live commit does not hold it; or the trunk lost the file. A button leaves no file: a person says so, the agent writes the release file, and until then nothing reads it

variants.name: a rollback by release, with its postmortem in draft
a rollback by a button, before the agent writes the file

told: a person says the host's button rolled production back

variants.name: a rollback by a button, after the agent writes the file

rows.title: A rollback, then a release of the trunk's tip that still holds the Spec
rows.says: the redo's line asks whether to cancel it

rows.title: A hotfix only on an environment branch
`spec.revise` after approval

revisions.why: a person asked for a change

rows.title: A delegated approval; the agent going on at `report`

variants.name: no approval, and the level allows it

rows.title: Narrow Task scopes, a wider diff, on a Spec that went on at `report`
rows.says: the changed paths give a stricter route, at which `spec.approve` asks, so the level no longer holds the approval
rows.unphrased: the finding that names the route

variants.name: the Spec went on at report, and the diff is wider than its scopes
the person approves, and the Spec is built

rows.title: An approval commit that was amended to change the outcome
A branch under a delegation that adds an `approval` to a result
rows.says: the delegated merge defers, so the agent asks the person

rows.title: A squash by the platform's button that drops the trailer

findings: its approval has no hold: the squash merge dropped its trailer. Run aidd approve INTENT-2

rows.title: A Spec under a draft Intent
An emergency Spec
rows.says: emergency route; committed at `built` in its repair's own change, as today; the trunk holds it

rows.title: `reaches: batched`; `reaches: flagged`
rows.says: the Intent ships at its last Spec, the launch

rows.title: A cancel asked on a merged Spec
rows.says: `aidd validate` errors, and names the revert
rows.unphrased: the error that names the revert

rows.title: A commit straight onto local `main`
rows.says: with a remote, the remote's trunk does not hold it; with none, the commit itself asks

rows.title: A planned Spec built in another repository, or routed minor
rows.says: the planned line counts as done on that commit's day. Its Intent then reads `shipped`, or `done` when it has no criteria

rows.title: One Spec cancelled, one done, on an Intent with criteria; an Intent with no Spec

variants.name: one Spec cancelled, one done, on an Intent with criteria

rows.title: A `done` Intent whose Spec rolls back months later
rows.says: Intent `done`, with a note; Spec `rolled_back`

rows.title: An Intent cancelled after it shipped
